checker: fact-checker CS-R2 (ships base-record sample; independent, seeded sample of 25 of 83 base records)
sample_method: Sample supplied by the coordinator: scratchpad/ships-base-sample.json, a seeded random sample of ships' 83 base records (25 ids). Every evidence row whose claim_id starts with one of the 25 ids was pulled from ledger/evidence.csv by script (361 rows).
decision_rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show (page-level: each row's page must carry every clause of its value; the session lesson 'cite one row per page that carries each clause'), tags a judgement as stated (parent 'independent', an EPA registrant read as parent, a ledger status class), places a company- or city-level fact at the plant where the shared-city/campus rule makes the attribution inferred, presents a plan as done, or the quote is not on the page (visible text and raw source, HTML-unescaped, checked; '...' fragments checked separately; never FOUND on an HTTP error page). Confirmed otherwise. Not additive: limiting parentheticals ('company-level', 'site role not stated', 'pre-production', 'approximate'), provenance labels ('EPA FRS', registry ids), and values that only restate a government record. Unreachable = no fresh 2xx read today after retries; never confirmed. Relationship and lookalike_of checked against the ships relationship rule (run_log 'Ships Stages B-C merged'): (a) Navy/Coast Guard combatant, auxiliary or submarine builders -> HII; (b) structural units, modules, hull sections for Navy yards -> HII; (c) barge, tug, towboat, workboat -> LAD Services; (d) unmanned or small military steel craft -> Saronic; other in-scope -> new; other LAD sites -> customer_other_plant. Construction (not repair-only) and steel (not aluminum-only) checked per the R2 boundary reading.
error_rate_note: 16/254 = 6.3% (page-level, the delegation's rule) over every stated row of the 25 records (167) plus every inferred row of relationship, lookalike_of, tier, tier_secondary, welder_postings and parent_company (87). Stated rows only: 16/167 = 9.6%. 1 row unreachable (WCT projects page, HTTP 502 five times), counted in the denominator as not confirmed; excluding it 16/253 = 6.3%. Joint-support reading: 7 of the 16 are rows of a compound value pasted identically onto two or three rows from different pages, where the set of rows together carries every clause (Hadrian products 5749, Hadrian triggers 5752/5753, Bludworth Galveston products 5868/5869, West Gulf products 6150/6151); counting those as supported gives 9/254 = 3.5%. No closed plant, wrong process, wrong tier, invented fact or wrong relationship found. No score effect (base records carry no scores). 7 OSHA headcount rows checked against data/osha_2025.csv by record ID: all fields match. 50 geocoder/Nominatim rows (inferred, outside the denominator) re-queried: all match the API response; BIW Brunswick's stored point is the EPA FRS Harding-facility point (43.91601,-69.885034), correctly kept over the geocoder's wrong '1 BATH RD' match 6 km west. Previous ships base sample (round 2): 13.0%.
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (16) has three repeated roots, each 3+ in a 25-plant sample. SWEEP (a), 7 rows: a compound value copied verbatim onto two or three evidence rows from different pages, each page carrying only some clauses (Hadrian products and triggers, Bludworth Galveston products, West Gulf products). Script: every claim_id with 2+ stated rows sharing an identical value but different source_urls; give each row only the clauses its page carries. In this sample 7 claims have 2+ stated rows with one value from different pages: 4 are defective (Hadrian products and triggers, Bludworth Galveston products, West Gulf products) and 3 are clean (New Pacific products, where both pages carry every clause, and the West Gulf and Sunflower address pairs).

SWEEP (b), 3 rows: judgements tagged stated: parent_company '(independent)' (John Bludworth 5590), an EPA facility registrant read as parent (Jemison 5668), and a ledger status class 'base (pre-production prospect)' (Anduril 4538). Script: stated rows of parent_company whose value contains 'independent', 'family-owned', 'no parent' or cites an EPA FRS name, and every stated status row.

SWEEP (c), 3 rows (4 with Sunflower 6193): a company or legal name, or a program name, carried from another page: 'Hadrian Automation' (on no cited page; pages say 'Hadrian'), 'Anduril Industries' (on gCaptain, cited to Breaking Defense), 'Trident Maritime Systems ... manufacturing' cited to an atlist map JSON that never names Trident. Script: for stated name and parent_company rows, check the value's distinctive tokens against the cited page text.

Single roots: a ZIP and street prefix added to a news-sourced address (New Pacific 5893); a grant-program name carried from the MARAD list onto a news row (Sunflower 6193, same family as sweep c); a scheduled delivery recorded as delivered (Jemison 5672, kind other).

method: Rows pulled by script from ledger/evidence.csv for the 25 sample ids (361 rows: 254 in scope under the key rows, and 107 inferred or unknown rows of other fields read but outside the denominator, under rows_read_out_of_scope). After the eye read, a script checked every number, date and proper noun in each confirmed stated value against that row's own page; the hits were resolved by hand (one more correction: Sunflower 6193). OSHA file searched for other Gulf Copper and Thoma-Sea establishments; ECHO DFR read for Thoma-Sea Lockport (110012383438, CAA synthetic-minor source, no status field). All 111 distinct cited URLs fetched fresh on 2026-11-19 with tools/fetch_page.fetch(with_raw=True) into the scratchpad: 104 answered 200 on the first pass; Nominatim (3) answered via curl with a generic client name after a 429; wctmarine.com (home, contact) and blountboats.com (no slash) answered on a fetch_page CLI retry after connection resets; wctmarine.com/projects returned 502 every time (unreachable). Each quote and each '...' fragment matched against normalised visible text plus raw source (HTML-unescaped). Then every in-scope row was read by eye against its page for value clauses, dates and site attribution. OSHA rows checked against data/osha_2025.csv by record ID. Census geocoder and Nominatim responses parsed and compared numerically with row values and plants.csv. EPA FRS JSON read for site lists (Thoma-Sea, Gulf Copper) and coordinates (BIW, FMT, John Bludworth). Live boards re-read: Dakota Creek employment page, LAD employment page, BIW iCIMS welder search, Vaia (Trident), Giddings welder page plus its WordPress REST record. Haversine check of the 25 against all plants (0.5 km). WebSearch used 3 times (of 5), discovery only, never quoted: Sunflower Dubuque, Thoma-Sea Lockport, Southwest Brady Island. evidence_row = 1-based CSV record number counting the header as row 1 (records, not physical lines; apply_factcheck matches on claim_id + source_url). No ledger file was edited.
apply_note: Not run against the ledger. Rows carry corrected_value / corrected_quote / corrected_tag / corrected_source_url and plants_csv_value in apply_factcheck.py's form. Fragments of multi-row claims carry '(keep current ...)' so plants.csv fields stay. Fields that change in plants.csv if applied: p-hadrian-cherokee-al parent_company -> 'Hadrian'; p-jemison-bayou-la-batre-al triggers -> scheduled-delivery wording; p-sunflower-dubuque-ia triggers -> grant wording without the program name. Retags only (field unchanged): Jemison parent_company, Anduril status. Field drift, leads, ruling questions and status problems are not applied by the script.
